description: Rezones 608 Broadway Avenue to standard commercial district.
Applies architectural controls for future development design.
Repeals previous zoning agreement for the site.

chips.text: Applicant West Cliff Developments plans new mixed-use building.
Previous development's failure to proceed was not explained.
One resident expressed concern about slope stability.

description: Rezones Brighton land for low to medium density housing.
Changes layout from dwelling groups to a block pattern.
Requires a raised median on Delainey Road for traffic.

chips.text: Affects residents in the Brighton neighbourhood.
One public comment sought clarification on the proposed layout change.

description: MPC members discussed attending the October SPPI conference.
Members will register themselves for the event.

chips.text: A $7,000 budget is available for member conference attendance.
Mastrofa expressed interest in attending the SPPI conference.
Public members of the Municipal Planning Commission.
Chair will coordinate payment for conference registrations.
